summary: Waldencast plc completed the sale of its Obagi Medical business on July 30, 2026, pursuant to a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated June 1, 2026. The Seller, Obagi Holdings Company Ltd., transferred 100% of Obagi Netherlands and Obagi AsiaPac, and Obagi Cosmeceuticals was acquired via two mergers with Waypoint Merger Subs I and II. Total consideration is up to $460 million, subject to customary adjustments, including a $10 million fixed vendor note, a $20 million adjustable vendor note, and up to $64 million in earnouts tied to 2026-2027 revenue milestones. CEO Michel Brousset, Chief Growth Officer Hind Sebti, and CFO Manuel Manfredi departed to lead Obagi; Chairman Felipe Dutra became Executive Chairman. No advisor or premium disclosed. Watch for transitional service performance and earnout achievement.
